title: चतुर्नवत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Karna declares that the Pandavas cannot be overcome by tricks, and that Draupadi will never turn against them. He urges an immediate attack on Drupada while the Pandavas are still without friends and strength, and Dhritarashtra calls his counsellors.
summary.kn: ಪಾಂಡವರನ್ನು ಉಪಾಯಗಳಿಂದ ಗೆಲ್ಲಲಾಗದು, ದ್ರೌಪದಿ ಅವರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ತಿರುಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಕರ್ಣನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪಾಂಡವರಿಗೆ ಮಿತ್ರರೂ ಬಲವೂ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರುವಾಗಲೇ ದ್ರುಪದನ ಮೇಲೆ ತಕ್ಷಣ ದಾಳಿ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂದು ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನು ಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕರೆಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: कर्ण घोषणा करते हैं कि पाण्डवों को छल से नहीं जीता जा सकता और द्रौपदी कभी उनके विरुद्ध नहीं होगी। वे आग्रह करते हैं कि पाण्डवों के मित्रहीन और दुर्बल रहते ही द्रुपद पर तुरन्त आक्रमण किया जाए, और धृतराष्ट्र मन्त्रियों को बुलाते हैं।
summary.te: పాండవులను ఉపాయాలతో జయించలేమని, ద్రౌపది వారికి వ్యతిరేకంగా మారదని కర్ణుడు చెబుతాడు. పాండవులకు మిత్రులు, బలం లేని ఇప్పుడే ద్రుపదునిపై వెంటనే దాడి చేయాలని పట్టుబడతాడు; ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు మంత్రులను పిలిపిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: பாண்டவர்களைச் சூழ்ச்சியால் வெல்ல முடியாது, திரௌபதி ஒருபோதும் அவர்களுக்கு எதிராகத் திரும்பமாட்டாள் என்று கர்ணன் சொல்கிறான். பாண்டவர்களுக்கு நண்பர்களும் வலிமையும் இல்லாத இப்போதே த்ருபதனை உடனே தாக்க வேண்டும் என்று வலியுறுத்த, திருதராஷ்டிரன் அமைச்சர்களை அழைக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: തന്ത്രങ്ങളാൽ പാണ്ഡവരെ കീഴടക്കാനാവില്ലെന്നും, ദ്രൗപദി ഒരിക്കലും അവർക്കെതിരെ തിരിയില്ലെന്നും കർണ്ണൻ പ്രഖ്യാപിക്കുന്നു. സുഹൃത്തുക്കളും ശക്തിയുമില്ലാത്ത പാണ്ഡവർ ഇപ്പോഴും ദുർബലരായിരിക്കെ ദ്രുപദനെ ഉടൻ ആക്രമിക്കാൻ അദ്ദേഹം ഉപദേശിക്കുന്നു; ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ഉപദേശകരെ വിളിച്ചുകൂട്ടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.194; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: कर्ण उवाच

meaning.en: Karna said:

verses.text:
दुर्योधन तव प्रज्ञा न सम्यगिति मे मतिः ।
न ह्युपायेन ते शक्याः पाण्डवाः कुरुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana, I think your reasoning is not sound, joy of the Kurus; the Pandavas cannot be overcome by stratagems.

verses.text:
पूर्वमेव हि ते सूक्ष्मैरुपायैर्यतितास्त्वया ।
निग्रहीतुं यदा वीर शकिता न तदा त्वया ॥

meaning.en: You tried subtle stratagems against them before, hero, and could not then subdue them.

verses.text:
इहैव वर्तमानास्ते समीपे तव पार्थिव ।
अजातपक्षाः शिशवः शकिता नैव बाधितुम् ॥

meaning.en: When they were living right here near you, king, as children without wings yet, you could not harm them.

verses.text:
जातपक्षा विदेशस्था विवृद्धाः सर्वशोऽद्य ते ।
नोपायसाध्याः कौन्तेया ममैषा मतिरच्युत ॥

meaning.en: Now they have grown wings, live abroad and are grown strong in every way; the sons of Kunti cannot be won by stratagems, that is my view, unfailing one.

verses.text:
न च ते व्यसनैर्योक्तुं शक्या दिष्टकृता हि ते ।
शङ्किताश्चेप्सवश्चैव पितृपैतामहं पदम् ॥

meaning.en: Nor can misfortunes be brought on them, since destiny made them what they are; they are suspected and yet they wish to claim their father's and grandfather's place.

verses.text:
परस्परेण भेदश्च नाधातुं तेषु शक्यते ।
एकस्यां ये रताः पत्न्यां न भिद्यन्ते परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: Nor can a split between them be created: those who delight in a single wife do not split from one another.

verses.text:
न चापि कृष्णा शक्येत तेभ्यो भेदयितुं परैः ।
परिद्यूनान्वृतवती किमुताद्य मृजावतः ॥

meaning.en: And Krishna cannot be turned against them by outsiders; she chose them when they were poor, how much less now, when they are rich.

verses.text:
ईप्सितश्च गुणः स्त्रीणामेकस्या बहुभर्तृता ।
तं च प्राप्तवती कृष्णा न सा भेदयितुं सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: For a woman, having several husbands is a desired quality, and Krishna has gained it; it is not easy to alienate her.

verses.text:
आर्यवृत्तश्च पाञ्चाल्यो न स राजा धनप्रियः ।
न संत्यक्ष्यति कौन्तेयान्राज्यदानैरपि ध्रुवम् ॥

meaning.en: The Panchala king is of noble conduct and not fond of wealth; he will certainly not abandon the sons of Kunti even for gifts of kingdoms.

verses.text:
तथास्य पुत्रो गुणवाननुरक्तश्च पाण्डवान् ।
तस्मान्नोपायसाध्यांस्तानहं मन्ये कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: His son too is virtuous and devoted to the Pandavas. So I think they cannot be won by stratagems in any way.

verses.text:
इदं त्वद्य क्षमं कर्तुमस्माकं पुरुषर्षभ ।
यावन्न कृतमूलास्ते पाण्डवेया विशां पते ।
तावत्प्रहरणीयास्ते रोचतां तव विक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: But this is what it is fitting for us to do now, bull among men: until the Pandavas have taken root, lord of the people, they should be struck. Let that be your resolve.

verses.text:
अस्मत्पक्षो महान्यावद्यावत्पाञ्चालको लघुः ।
तावत्प्रहरणं तेषां क्रियतां मा विचारय ॥

meaning.en: While our side is large and the Panchala is small, let the attack on them be made; do not hesitate.

verses.text:
वाहनानि प्रभूतानि मित्राणि बहुलानि च ।
यावन्न तेषां गान्धारे तावदेवाशु विक्रम ॥

meaning.en: While they have not yet got many vehicles and many friends, son of Gandhari, act at once.

verses.text:
यावच्च राजा पाञ्चाल्यो नोद्यमे कुरुते मनः ।
सह पुत्रैर्महावीर्यैस्तावदेवाशु विक्रम ॥

meaning.en: While the Panchala king with his mighty sons has not set his mind to action, act at once.

verses.text:
यावन्नायाति वार्ष्णेयः कर्षन्यादववाहिनीम् ।
राज्यार्थे पाण्डवेयानां तावदेवाशु विक्रम ॥

meaning.en: While the Vrishni Krishna has not come leading the Yadava army for the Pandavas' kingdom, act at once.

verses.text:
वसूनि विविधान्भोगान्राज्यमेव च केवलम् ।
नात्याज्यमस्ति कृष्णस्य पाण्डवार्थे महीपते ॥

meaning.en: There is nothing, king, that Krishna would not give up for the Pandavas: riches, pleasures of many kinds, or even a kingdom.

verses.text:
विक्रमेण मही प्राप्ता भरतेन महात्मना ।
विक्रमेण च लोकांस्त्रीञ्जितवान्पाकशासनः ॥

meaning.en: The earth was won by great-souled Bharata through valour, and by valour Indra, who punished Paka, conquered the three worlds.

verses.text:
विक्रमं च प्रशंसन्ति क्षत्रियस्य विशां पते ।
स्वको हि धर्मः शूराणां विक्रमः पार्थिवर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Lord of the people, they praise valour as the Kshatriya's way; valour is the own dharma of heroes, bull among kings.

verses.text:
ते बलेन वयं राजन्महता चतुरङ्गिणा ।
प्रमथ्य द्रुपदं शीघ्रमानयामेह पाण्डवान् ॥

meaning.en: King, let us with a great army of four divisions crush Drupada and quickly bring the Pandavas here.

verses.text:
न हि साम्ना न दानेन न भेदेन च पाण्डवाः ।
शक्याः साधयितुं तस्माद्विक्रमेणैव ताञ्जहि ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas cannot be won by conciliation, gifts or division; therefore kill them by valour alone.

verses.text:
तान्विक्रमेण जित्वेमामखिलां भुङ्क्ष्व मेदिनीम् ।
नान्यमत्र प्रपश्यामि कार्योपायं जनाधिप ॥

meaning.en: Having conquered them by valour, enjoy this whole earth. I see no other means to the end here, lord of men.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
श्रुत्वा तु राधेयवचो धृतराष्ट्रः प्रतापवान् ।
अभिपूज्य ततः पश्चादिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Radheya's words, the powerful Dhritarashtra honoured him and then spoke these words.

verses.text:
उपपन्नं महाप्राज्ञे कृतास्त्रे सूतनन्दने ।
त्वयि विक्रमसंपन्नमिदं वचनमीदृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said: Such words of valour are fitting from you, son of the charioteer, very wise and skilled in weapons.

verses.text:
भूय एव तु भीष्मश्च द्रोणो विदुर एव च ।
युवां च कुरुतां बुद्धिं भवेद्या नः सुखोदया ॥

meaning.en: Let Bhishma, Drona, Vidura and you two once more form a plan that will bring us happiness.

verses.text:
तत आनाय्य तान्सर्वान्मन्त्रिणः सुमहायशाः ।
धृतराष्ट्रो महाराज मन्त्रयामास वै तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then the greatly renowned Dhritarashtra, great king, summoned all his counsellors and took counsel.
